actors.name: Marguerite
actors.private_context: Marguerite is the owner of the Copper Kettle bistro. She typically replies to most reviews within days, and her replies tend to be defensive. She has just become aware of a one-star review posted last night complaining about a 45-minute wait on a night the bistro was short two servers.

shared_context: A one-star review of the Copper Kettle bistro was posted on a major review site last night. The review mentions a 45-minute wait and that the bistro was short two servers that night. The review site allows business owners to post public replies to reviews.

starting_events.description: Marguerite sees the one-star review on the review site.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Marguerite posted a public reply to the review on the review site before 2026-09-06T09:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
